payload.text: hv, 19 Oct 2026, directly to vc: "Cut without 0072, ship it next release." This replaces decision 41's wait. 2.14.1's code is 910af45, and dc's 178 (with ic's 179 and the AT27 run alone) is the final-head gate, followed by the report and the dry run under a freeze of every node's code and board. 0072 moves to the next release. Gtools' arca_swift 0.2.0 no longer gates Utilz and goes at Gtools' own pace. utilz-ic adopts it after the cut, in a worktree, and lands nothing on main until 2.14.1's CI and tap are done. vc's call on decision 42, the TMPDIR leftovers: they are test-only, so the fix lands straight after the cut rather than forcing a second gate. One word from hv puts it back in 2.14.1, at the cost of an M-sized gate rerun.
